long_biography.plain_text:
Kortlevers grew up in Amsterdam's Watergraafsmeer as the son of a contractor. When his father was injured, he began helping in the family company while still a teenager. As an engineering student in 1990, he bought and subdivided a property in Zaandam, then repeated the model across Amsterdam. Construction experience led him toward development, and the financial crisis shifted his attention to distressed real estate and leisure assets.

LMEY became the vehicle for hotel and resort investments, including a German ski-and-hotel complex, a TUI-operated Austrian resort and a stake in premium club operator Aldiana. In 2017, LMEY partnered with Thomas Cook on a platform to acquire and upgrade destination hotels. Kortlevers subsequently concentrated on OKU's design-led resorts, extending the portfolio across Mediterranean destinations while retaining an acquisition-and-repositioning strategy.

A deceased Johannes Jacobus 'Hans' Kortlevers born in 1939 is an older namesake and is excluded by the birth year, alive status and contemporary business evidence.

The authoritative input gives Envy as 40.94 metres and 369 GT, while YachtAhoy and SuperYachtFan use approximately 41 metres and 361 GT. The shared 1995 Lürssen build, name and length make this a minor tonnage-data discrepancy rather than evidence of a different vessel.

Johannes Jacobus Kortlevers is the exact legal identity preserved in the owner record. Hans is the established Dutch professional diminutive already present as an upstream alias and used by the LinkedIn profile, interview, business coverage and yacht sources; no display-name correction is proposed.

The detailed profile calls Kortlevers an Amsterdammer and says he grew up in Watergraafsmeer, but it does not explicitly state that he was born in Amsterdam. A self-presented exact-name profile does make that claim, but no second strong source was found, so place_of_birth remains unproposed.

Quote explicitly reports 1 April 1970, SuperYachtFan repeats the full date, and Companies House confirms April 1970 for the exact legal name. Birth day 1 is therefore proposed at 96 confidence; the already populated month and year are not redundantly proposed.

Self-made — advantaged start distinguishes a founder-built portfolio from an inherited fortune while recognizing the relevant family platform. Kortlevers entered his contractor father's business as a teenager, then made his own first purchase and developed an independent real-estate investment record. Public sources do not disclose whether family capital funded the first property.

Real Estate captures the original wealth mechanism of acquisition, subdivision, development and distressed repositioning. Hospitality captures the current LMEY and OKU hotel focus. Investor is used because repeated capital allocation into assets is the causal mechanism; Founder remains an important role but is secondary to the cross-platform investment relationship.

Public sources vary between more than twenty and twenty-two hotels and between approximately 4,000 and 5,500 staff. REWE also documents the 2022 disposal of LMEY's Aldiana stake. The biographies therefore avoid portfolio totals and do not imply that historical holdings remain current.
